social._readme: Follower counts shown in the footer's social cards, read from each public profile (LinkedIn company page: its search snippet, as LinkedIn hides it behind a login). Update with the date.

tokensLive._readme: The hero dial counts tokens live: base at 'from', plus perDay since. Base: 522B+ in Shaan's bios (read 9 Oct). perDay: 3.17B measured for 8 Oct with ccusage over the Claude logs on both Macs (laptop 2.44B, Mac mini 0.73B; laptop alone 2.41B on 6 Oct, 2.01B on 7 Oct). Cloud sessions and Codex are not counted, so it is a floor. Shaan, 9 Oct: 'today I think it's like 3 billion'. Re-measure with npx ccusage daily.

repos._readme: One entry per product repo for GitHub buttons. public=false shows 'Opening on GitHub' instead of a star count; set public and stars when Shaan makes a repo public.
